title: Movix v2.3.1 - Mobile True Fullscreen & High-Fidelity AdMob Fix
changelog: True Edge-to-Edge Fullscreen on Mobile: Automatic rotation to horizontal landscape on cinema player launch with display cutout / notch edge-to-edge immersion and zero black letterbox bars (100% Zoom to Fill)
Enhanced Fullscreen Toggle: Fullscreen maximize button seamlessly expands view to 100% display width and height without exiting or glitching

High-Fidelity AdMob Visibility: Fixed advertisement premature dismissal bug; advertisements now render cleanly with prominent Google AdMob branding, unclipped safe-area header, visible 5-second countdown timer, and glowing Skip Ad button
Guaranteed Pre-roll Commercials: Ensured pre-roll video ads play smoothly before movie starts without blank screen or instant 40ms auto-skip
Sponsored In-App Banners: Enhanced VIP 4K Pass sponsored card with official Google AdMob branding and instant rewarded ad trigger
Continuous Multi-Audio Dub Switching: Smooth audio language switching across Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam, and English preserved at exact timestamp
